description: Three weaknesses where nothing is interpreted and nothing leaks. Writing to PATH chooses which binary a later exec runs, and that exec looks entirely normal afterwards, which is the point -- the negative writes an environment variable that decides nothing. Sizing an allocation from a request is choosing when the process runs out of memory. And a lenient HTTP parser is what lets a server disagree with the proxy in front of it about where one request ends. The two environment writes are the same shape at two granularities: one names a search path and one does not, and exactly one rule fires on each, which is what the exclusion between them is for.

expected.note: the caller prepends a directory to the executable search path
